MRTRONO.AltarHelp: Record events in the fiction. Updating a vessel does not automatically apply statuses, free victims, or break seals. Resolve these actions with the official tools, then record the outcome here.
MRTRONO.NebPanelHelp: Open his sheet and the banquet chapters for motivations, threats, temptations, and reactions. Record the ritual, both seals, and the heart in Campaign.

MRTRONO.NativeStatusesHelp: This list reads Mist Engine statuses directly. Apply, weaken, or remove statuses through the official sheet after resolving the action with its rules.

MRTRONO.RemoveMemory: Remove this memory from the record
MRTRONO.PerceivedOnly: This record is visible to people with access to the Actor. Do not enter Narrator secrets. Marking a memory as threatened or recovered records the fiction only; it does not modify statuses or tags.
MRTRONO.OwnerOnly: You must own this Hero to edit their memories.
MRTRONO.AnimationsHelp: Animate the border of threatened memories. Text remains readable and the device’s reduced-motion preference is respected.
MRTRONO.WrongSystem: The Throne of Thirst requires the official mist-engine-fvtt system.
MRTRONO.Guide1: Import the Adventure from Campaign. It is offered once to the active Narrator in an empty world. Reopening import from this panel never overwrites existing documents.
MRTRONO.Guide2: Open Heroes and assign Actor ownership to each player using Foundry. Keep the official Mist Engine sheets: themes, tags, equipment, rotes, and rolls are used there.
MRTRONO.Guide3: Open the Book of Memories and record a bond, a memory, and an important object for each Hero. Save your changes. Alt+M opens this book; Alt+B opens the Narrator panel.
MRTRONO.Guide4: Open sessions, clues, and Challenges through journals. View shows a Scene to you; Activate shows it to the group. Show to players is available only for player handouts.
MRTRONO.Guide5: Resolve forgetting through official actions and statuses. The Book of Memories reads those statuses; narrative markers grant no Power and replace no rules. Altar and Campaign record outcomes agreed at the table.
MRTRONO.Guide6: Save the altar and notes when a scene ends. Edited documents, memories, and progress persist in the world across module updates. Preserve your edits and compare them with the compendium when reviewing new content.

MRTRONO.TutorialsHelp: A native Foundry tour of each book. Exit, move backward or forward, and repeat it whenever you wish.
MRTRONO.NarratorTutorialDescription: Explore the campaign, Heroes, altar, and adventure documents.
MRTRONO.PlayerTutorialDescription: Learn to record bonds and memories without duplicating Mist Engine rules.
MRTRONO.ToursUnavailable: The tutorials could not be loaded. The written guide remains available in the Book of the Dead.
MRTRONO.TourGMWelcomeText: This book gathers your Narrator tools. The tour opens each section before highlighting it. You can exit at any time; the tour does not change adventure progress.
MRTRONO.TourGMCampaignText: Record fictional outcomes: ritual, both seals, heart, clues, and threats. The active Narrator saves these changes. No consequences or rolls are resolved automatically.
MRTRONO.TourGMHeroesText: Open native Hero and Challenge sheets here. Assign each Hero’s ownership to their player through Foundry. Themes, tags, Backpack, Rotes, and rolls are used on those official sheets.
MRTRONO.TourGMAltarText: Each vessel has a state and space for its victim’s story. Six names begin captive and the seventh vessel is empty. Update the record after the group’s actions take effect, then Save: progress persists in this world.
MRTRONO.TourGMDocumentsText: View shows a Scene on your screen only; Activate switches the players’ Scene. Player handouts have their own Show button. Narrator journals are never broadcast through this panel.
MRTRONO.TourGMNebText: Open his sheet and the related chapters for motivations, threats, temptations, and reactions. Record promises made to each Hero here. Private details are stored in the Narrator record.
MRTRONO.TourGMFinishText: The written guide remains in this section. Alt+B opens this book; Alt+M opens memories. Repeat these tours from Settings → Guided tours or Foundry’s Tours manager. Save any edits before beginning a tour.
MRTRONO.TourPlayerWelcomeText: Record what your Hero knows and perceives. You may edit only Heroes you own. If no Hero is assigned yet, your Narrator can assign one before you repeat this tour.
MRTRONO.TourPlayerSheetTitle: The rules live on your sheet
MRTRONO.TourPlayerSheetText: This button opens the official Mist Engine sheet. Themes, tags, equipment, rotes, rolls, and statuses remain the rules source. This book reads current statuses without keeping a second copy.
MRTRONO.TourPlayerIdentityText: Write the name by which your Hero knows themself. This is a narrative record: changing it does not erase an identity, grant Power, or alter themes on the sheet.
MRTRONO.TourPlayerBondsText: Record important relationships and bonds with other Heroes. Tell the Narrator which objects, gestures, or memories can anchor those bonds during the adventure.
MRTRONO.TourPlayerMemoryText: Each entry records a memory, its anchor, and its narrative situation. Marking it threatened or recovered records what happened; statuses and tiers are resolved by the rules and managed on the official sheet. If there are no entries yet, add them after leaving the tutorial.
MRTRONO.TourPlayerSaveText: Save after editing. Add memory also preserves the current entries before adding a new one. Do not enter Narrator secrets: this record belongs to the Actor. Alt+M opens it again; repeat the tour from Settings.
MRTRONO.PrivateLockedHelp: This world contains an encrypted campaign, and this browser has no valid key. The campaign has not been changed or reset. Restore a local JSON backup to continue in this browser.
MRTRONO.PrivateBackupHelp: Notes are encrypted before being saved in the world. The key remains in this Narrator’s browser. Download a backup to recover them when changing browsers or clearing browser data.
MRTRONO.PrivateBackupWarning: The downloaded backup contains your private notes in plaintext. Keep it private; do not include it in the module or share it with players.
MRTRONO.PastePrivateBackup: Paste the contents of your local JSON backup
MRTRONO.InvalidPrivateBackup: The pasted data is not a valid campaign backup. No data has been changed.
MRTRONO.RestorePrivateWarning: The pasted backup will replace this world’s encrypted private notes. Check that it is the copy you want to restore. Other world documents are unchanged.
MRTRONO.NoPrivateRegistry: Import the adventure before restoring its private notes.

MRTRONO.SceneTutorialDescription: Tour of the Narrator bar: move it, show scenes, depth-aware figures, ambience and milestones.
MRTRONO.TourSceneBarText: Hold the right mouse button here and drag the bar out of the way. It remembers its position. “More controls” has “Center bar” and the arrow on the right collapses it to one row.
MRTRONO.TourSceneShowText: Activates the scene for the table and starts its music. “Read scene” opens the text prepared to be read aloud.
MRTRONO.TourSceneFiguresText: Pick the spawn size and resize the figures already present. Scenes never place characters by themselves: bring them from the journal or with “Place heroes”.
MRTRONO.TourSceneDepthText: Every background knows its floor. With this option figures stand on real spots and shrink as they move away and grow as they come closer, also when you drag them.
MRTRONO.TourSceneAmbientText: Bright, dim or dark: changes the scene light and the score volume together. It is remembered per scene.
MRTRONO.TourSceneHitosText: Mark here what the table discovers (Alt+H). Players see progress without spoilers and get a notice on each new milestone.
MRTRONO.TourPlayerHitosText: This badge (Alt+H) shows what the group has discovered. The Narrator unlocks each milestone during play and you will get a notice.
